name: Mat | Analytics
tagline: Ask questions of your org schema and get reports, charts, no writes
description: A place to ask questions of a confirmed organisation schema and the event history behind it. Answers come back as tabular reports and charts, built only from what is actually recorded rather than inferred. The seat is read-only by design - it cannot write anything back and it cannot reshape the model.
author: damianoredem
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
